fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-start-ready-dispatch|change-workflow-pin|bugfix-workflow-autonomous|daemon-root-ship-workflow)$' passes with ship-change the conductor default, run-start-ready-dispatch and change-workflow-pin showing the default's dry run on a leafless change set succeeding with '- Workflow: ship-change'; go test -trimpath ./internal/daemon -run 'TestResumable|TestPick|TestSkips' passes. Touches cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/run-start-ready-dispatch.txtar, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/change-workflow-pin.txtar, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/bugfix-workflow-autonomous.txtar, cmd/rhiza/testdata/script/daemon-root-ship-workflow.txtar and internal/daemon/pick_test.go.
fields.statement: The existing tests of the default ship-change itself follow the conductor default: run-start-ready-dispatch.txtar and change-workflow-pin.txtar expect the default's dry run to start a leafless change set (no 'ship-change builds and reviews its leaves' or leaves-step refusal); bugfix-workflow-autonomous.txtar and daemon-root-ship-workflow.txtar assert the new builtin's steps; and the daemon pick tests in internal/daemon/pick_test.go that assert a step of the default name the new builtin's steps. No test is deleted.
